value.residual: The retained production-bound InMemory ActionIR method loads the exact current verified ActionIR artifact, persisted policy, grant, resource, authorization epoch, replacement receipt, and monotonic trusted logical-time watermark inside one candidate-state commit, runs the deterministic checker, and atomically publishes the action effect plus authorization-bound receipt. Exact replay is mutation-inert but rechecks current artifact/authority and retry time before result disclosure; fresh-commit and post-commit exact-retry revocation races both deny with no duplicate business effect or prior-result disclosure. Tests also cover valid exact and lost-reply replay, revocation/expiry, stale or substituted bindings, owner CAS, and artifact/provenance/receipt tampering. The authenticated HTTP ActionIR route (server-side expectations and trusted logical time) and the Turso injected-persistence-failure and reopen tests were removed in #2764 (not currently covered); trusted logical time is supplied by the test caller. Other mutation families still use narrower authorization boundaries; governed network provisioning, strong-receipt projection in aggregate evidence, effect-program-to-proposed-effect correspondence, and Rust-to-Lean/Quint refinement are not claimed. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code.
